hooks.command: echo '📋 Loading project context...' && if [ -f docs/sprint-status.yaml ]; then echo '\n📌 Current Sprint Status:' && cat docs/sprint-status.yaml | head -20; fi && echo '\n🔄 Git Status:' && git status --short 2>/dev/null || echo 'Not a git repo yet'
if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'rm\s+-rf|rm\s+-r\s+/|>\/dev\/'; then echo '{"decision": "block", "reason": "Dangerous command blocked"}'; fi

filepath=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -oE '"file_path":\s*"[^"]+"' | cut -d'"' -f4); if [[ "$filepath" == *"/src/"* ]] || [[ "$filepath" == *"/apps/"* ]]; then echo '\n💡 Tip: Consider running tests after implementation'; fi
echo '\n✏️ File edited - Remember to update story checklist if task completed'
echo "\n✅ Subagent task completed at $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')" >> .claude/workflow-log.txt && echo '📝 Subagent work logged'
